coordinateFrames.note: Nominal 250 mm module envelope; dimensions remain locked in params.

coordinateFrames.origin: external rail datum at indexed dock centerline
coordinateFrames.note: Dock pitch and land geometry remain TARGET/UNVERIFIED until sourced.
B20 keeps every conductor outside this frame.

interfaces.title: Animal/wet-volume barrier
interfaces.statement: B20 continuously separates every conductor, pogo, and metal mesh from the animal and wet volumes.
interfaces.notes: Architectural lock; physical keep-out evidence is still required for shop release.

interfaces.title: Indexed high-speed pogo dock
interfaces.statement: B27 is the stationary indexed serialized-video dock (P09-P12 class) crossed only while the carriage is not translating.
interfaces.notes: Contact series, impedance, and BER remain unverified.

interfaces.title: Guarded continuous rail strip
interfaces.statement: B48 names the guarded continuous power/control/identity/diagnostic lands (P01-P08 class) on the external rail.
interfaces.notes: Electrical values remain TARGET/REF/UNVERIFIED until sourced and measured.

interfaces.title: Keyed binder-to-carriage handoff
interfaces.statement: B50 is a second keyed 12-net binder electrical interface, distinct from B27, carrying serialized video plus protected power/control only while seated.
interfaces.notes: Physical connector series and pinout are unverified; do not invent SKUs.

interfaces.title: Carriage mate interlock
interfaces.statement: S1 is a local mechanical normally-open carriage mate interlock supervising rail mate; it must open on first pinch travel before contacts lift.

interfaces.title: Binder mate interlock
interfaces.statement: S2 is a local mechanical normally-open binder mate interlock; binder release stays mechanically blocked unless the carriage is pinch-safe.

interfaces.title: Per-carriage local load switch
interfaces.statement: Q1 switches only the local carriage load branch and may enable only when S1 and S2 are both closed, only for a bounded training window, and must turn off and discharge before lift.

interlocks.closedMeans: carriage fully seated and pinch not started
interlocks.openMeans: first pinch travel; local branch must already be off and discharging

discharge.note: Selected discharge voltage/time limits are not yet measured.

interlocks.openMeans: binder not safely mated; Q1 must remain off

interlocks.closedMeans: bounded training or admitted link while S1 and S2 closed
interlocks.openMeans: mute video, isolate low-speed, and discharge before any separable interface moves

discharge.note: No PASS until discharge limits are recorded.

faultModes.detection: pinch released before lift or mate geometry becomes ambiguous
faultModes.requiredAction: keep-Q1-off and require clean full remate; do not restore video

faultModes.detection: local branch voltage collapses below selected threshold during train/admit
S1, S2, or Q1 sense disagrees with commanded/mechanical state
faultModes.requiredAction: treat as fault-latched; forbid Q1 enable and binder release

faultModes.detection: B27 or B50 seating, bounce, or wipe state is not fully seated/clear
faultModes.requiredAction: keep-Q1-off; no video; settle or clean remate

faultModes.detection: any single-fault path that would energize while contacts move
faultModes.requiredAction: local branch off until clean detach and branch-safe clear

adrs.title: Raw MIPI stays local; carriage video is serialized and stationary-only
adrs.decision: Encode camera path as module → local MIPI → serializer → B50 → carriage routing → B27 → deserializer → local CSI → Tachyon. Raw MIPI never rides the rail; video-while-rolling is out of v1.
consequences: bus.json cameraPath must eventually list carriage-routing and B27 explicitly
EE/MCAD leaves consume this registry rather than inventing hop order

adrs.title: S1/S2/Q1 are structural interlocks, not labels
adrs.decision: Transitions declare guards and actions; discharge, interruption, brownout, stuck-switch, and contact-ambiguous faults are first-class modes.
consequences: Free-form state prose cannot satisfy acceptance
Measured discharge thresholds remain unverified until evidence exists

adrs.title: Manifest generation, review, and verification stay separate
adrs.decision: A verifier never mints or rewrites the baseline it certifies. Generated digests require an explicit review promotion before baseline use.
consequences: smoke manifests under evidence/generated remain non-baseline
terrarium/MANIFEST.sha256 is an immutable baseline checked, never regenerated, by verify

adrs.title: SpecimenDB projection binds only reviewed claim admissions
adrs.decision: Projection payloads may reference only claimRefs present on an accepted EvidenceRecord admission. Caller prose cannot borrow provenance. URI artifacts require digests. Records stay local until gbg#16.
consequences: gbg#16 owns packages/specimendb and the TypeScript attach adapter files
No direct PGlite; lab is not a Specimen; no invented GPS/taxon
